tw.$description: The shadcn/ui contract: every semantic slot a stock shadcn component resolves, as a Tailwind v4 @theme key. Nothing here holds a value — every token is a pure alias onto a core token, and the generator throws if one is not, because a literal here would be the beginning of a second palette. Add a slot here rather than overriding a component.

color-popover.$description: shadcn `popover`. Same surface as a card in both themes — that is shadcn's own default, and it is what keeps a popover legible over a light background.

color-primary.$description: shadcn `primary`. Follows [data-accent], so a stock <Button> re-tints with the user's accent for free.

color-primary-foreground.$description: shadcn `primary-foreground`. Not always white — teal, green and amber take dark ink in the dark theme.

color-secondary.$description: shadcn `secondary`. The borderless secondary button surface.

color-muted.$description: shadcn `muted`. The inset surface behind fields, chips and badges.

color-accent.$description: shadcn `accent` is the neutral hover/active surface for menu and list items, NOT the brand colour — that is `primary`. This is the one trap in the mapping, which is why --color-brand exists below.

color-input.$description: shadcn `input` is the field's border colour, not its fill — and a field's border is what identifies the control, so it takes the 3:1 variant rather than the decorative one (WCAG 1.4.11).

color-border-strong.$description: NON-shadcn, ours. The 3:1 boundary for any control shadcn does not route through `input`: switch track, segmented button, checkbox.

color-ring.$description: shadcn `ring` — the focus ring, which is never removed, only restyled. Use it at FULL alpha (`ring-ring`), never shadcn's stock `ring-ring/50`: the accent at 50% over --bg measures 1.78-2.98 across the six accents and fails WCAG 1.4.11.

color-sidebar-foreground.$description: shadcn `sidebar-foreground`. Nav items rest dim and go --text on hover.

color-sidebar-accent.$description: shadcn `sidebar-accent` is the ACTIVE nav item, so it maps to the accent-tinted --selected rather than to the neutral hover above.

color-sidebar-border.$description: shadcn `sidebar-border`. A region separator, not a control edge.

color-chart-1.$description: shadcn `chart-1`. The chart ramp reuses the content-kind hues, so a chart is legible next to the list it describes.

color-brand.$description: NON-shadcn, ours. An unambiguous name for the brand accent, because shadcn has already spent the word `accent` on its hover surface. `bg-brand` and `bg-primary` are the same colour; prefer `brand` outside shadcn components.

color-brand-2.$description: NON-shadcn, ours. The text-safe accent step. Accent-coloured TEXT uses this; `text-primary`/`text-brand` is a fill and measures 3.21-4.37 as text depending on the accent.

color-selected.$description: NON-shadcn, ours. The accent-tinted list-row selection fill, exposed as a utility rather than an inline style.

color-pressed.$description: NON-shadcn, ours. The neutral pressed state layer.

color-withheld.$description: NON-shadcn, ours. The slot standing in for a sensitive item's absent content (INV-10). A fill, not a filter — there is no blur token and there must not be one.

color-withheld-border.$description: NON-shadcn, ours. The reveal affordance is a real button (A11Y-3), so its boundary carries the 1.4.11 weight.

radius.$description: shadcn's base radius variable — 10px, its own 0.625rem default. The four steps below are derived from it exactly as shadcn derives them.

radius-md.$description: base − 2px. `rounded-md`, the default on Button and Input.

radius-xl.$description: base + 4px. `rounded-xl`, the default on Card and Dialog.

ease-cp.$description: Tailwind `ease-cp`. The single CopyPaste easing curve.
